title: Kona Blue documents admit capability to implant false memories

tellings.quote: In those documents, the United States government is admitting they have the capability to give you false memories, mess with your brain, make you do things, and that's without drugs.

plain: Papers from a US government programme called Kona Blue are said to show the government admitting it can plant false memories, interfere with people's minds and make them do things, without using drugs. The claim comes from a man named Dylan Borland, who says a top government official told him aliens run everything. He tells Michels: "In those documents, the United States government is admitting they have the capability to give you false memories, mess with your brain, make you do things, and that's without drugs." The telling does not quote the papers themselves, so what they actually say about this is left open.
